import ctypes
import os

# Load the dependent libraries
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the result structure class
class GSLResult(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("val", ctypes.c_double),
        ("err", ctypes.c_double)
    ]

# Define the function prototype for gsl_sf_bessel_J1_e
# int gsl_sf_bessel_J1_e(const double x, gsl_sf_result * result)
gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_J1_e.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.POINTER(GSLResult)]
gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_J1_e.restype = ctypes.c_int

def compute_bessel_J1(x):
    """Compute the first-order Bessel function of the first kind (J1) for a given input."""
    result = GSLResult()
    status = gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_J1_e(ctypes.c_double(x), ctypes.byref(result))
    if status != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"GSL error with status code: {status}")
    return result.val

    """Run assertion tests to validate correctness and robustness."""

    assert abs(compute_bessel_J1(-1.0) + 0.4400505857449335) < 1e-10, "Test case 3 failed"
    assert abs(compute_bessel_J1(3.0) - 0.3390589585259365) < 1e-10, "Test case 4 failed"
